mechanism: Source-certified knowledge withdrawal plus explicit dependency invalidation, rather than append-only warning or schema-option erasure. Strong rival: task decomposition/answer construction dominates, so even zero certified-failed calls does not improve completion/core quality. Calls and finish fields are mediators/stop conditions, not root-cause proof.
